description: Workout, ride, and music history from your Peloton account in the terminal. First catalog CLI to harvest the Auth0 SPA bearer token from a browser session, then mirror history into a local SQLite store with FTS5 search.

auth_env_var_specs.name: PELOTON_USERNAME
auth_env_var_specs.description: Peloton account email or username consumed by `auth login` to pre-fill the Auth0 sign-in form. Optional — you can sign in by hand inside the spawned Chrome window.

auth_env_var_specs.name: PELOTON_PASSWORD
auth_env_var_specs.description: Peloton account password consumed by `auth login` to pre-fill the Auth0 sign-in form. Optional — you can sign in by hand.

auth_env_var_specs.name: PELOTON_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Bearer token populated automatically by `auth login` and read by authenticated commands. Do not set manually — use `auth login` instead. The token is the Auth0 SPA `body.access_token` extracted from the `@@auth0spajs@@::<client_id>::https://api.onepeloton.com/::openid offline_access` localStorage entry; lifetime is ~1 hour Peloton-side.

novel_features.name: Auth0 SPA bearer-token harvest
novel_features.description: Spawns Chrome via chromedp, lets the user sign in to members.onepeloton.com normally, then extracts the Auth0 SPA `body.access_token` from the @@auth0spajs@@::<client_id>::https://api.onepeloton.com/::openid offline_access localStorage entry. Discovers the Auth0 client_id at runtime; strips the auth0|<id> prefix from the cached profile so /api/user/{id}/workouts accepts the bare id.

novel_features.name: Liked-songs cross-ride digest
novel_features.description: Walks the most-recent N workouts, fetches each ride playlist in parallel, collects songs flagged liked=true in-class, and dedupes by song id with a times_played counter across the scanned window. No Peloton UI surfaces this view; likes are stored Peloton-side per ride playback rather than per-song globally.
